test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Who were the pioneers of the concept of PIL in India?

options.text: Justice V. R. Krishna Iyer and P. Sathasivam
Justice P. N. Bhagwati and A. N. Ray
Justice P. Sadashivam and P.N. Bhagwati
Justice V. R. Krishna Iyer and P.N. Bhagwati

solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice V. R. Krishna Iyer and P.N. Bhagwati**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Justice V. R. Krishna Iyer and Justice P.N. Bhagwati were the pioneers of the concept of Public Interest Litigation (PIL) in India.
 
• Public Interest Litigation (PIL) allows individuals or groups to file petitions in court on behalf of those whose rights are being violated and who are unable to approach the court themselves.
 
• This concept has significantly broadened the scope of judicial intervention in matters of public interest, ensuring justice for marginalized and disadvantaged sections of society.
 
• Justice V. R. Krishna Iyer and Justice P.N. Bhagwati used PIL as a tool to make justice more accessible and to promote social justice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice V. R. Krishna Iyer** served as a judge of the Supreme Court of India from 1973 to 1980 and was known for his progressive judgments and contributions to human rights jurisprudence.
 
• **Justice P.N. Bhagwati** served as the Chief Justice of India from 1985 to 1986 and was instrumental in expanding the concept of PIL.
 
• The introduction of PIL has led to numerous landmark judgments in India, addressing issues such as environmental protection, human rights, and governmental accountability.
 
• PIL has become an essential part of the Indian judicial system, empowering citizens to seek justice on a wide range of public issues.
